name: Trace-only raw-second conservation after head compensation

mathematics.original: d_after=d_before-(1+RC-KC)*(2*h*dm+dm^2); m_after=h+dm, where dm is already FHM-effective.
mathematics.fixed_arm: For every L1..14, eta=(RC-KC)*mean(2*h*dm+dm^2); replace only outgoing float64 diagonal d_after by d_after+eta before original C64/C32 paired diagonal writes.
mathematics.property: In real arithmetic preserves pair-map total raw second moment while retaining all offdiagonal compensation and differences among marginal variances. No PSD or nonnegative-diagonal guarantee.
mathematics.interpretation: Tests whether the learned mean correction should change the distribution of marginal variances but not the pair formula total energy. Existing RC/KC calibration may intentionally repair total energy too; therefore this is not a theorem that accuracy improves.
mathematics.scope: Same effective dm, means, covariance offdiagonals, targets, radial source, gq, state sizes and selection algorithms. Future values/rosters can change. No arm strength, bands, fitting, alternative directions, or outcome-based coefficient.

placement: Current _astra_fhm_core: after original _gn_rc block, before _ps_post_cov32=C; both existing fill_diagonal calls consume repaired d64. Existing _ps_mdm_diag supplies h*dm; no source/cache alias reuse beyond the active call.

history.bounded_search: No explicit trace-only raw-second head compensation found in TEAM_LOG and physicist source. Not an exhaustive novelty claim.
history.rejected_here: gq [0,1] clipping had only tiny tail effect on all eight archived S42 captures; no model slot proposed.

diagnostic.scope: Existing eight completed public S42 parent trajectories; current RC/KC literals substituted only to bound scale. No current-parent gain inference, residual/truth reads, or fitting.
diagnostic.finding: |eta|/mean(prevariance) median2.56e-6, max3.25e-5; signs mixed67positive/45negative. Largest one-step Gaussian mean perturbation1.18e-6 RMS per unit squared weight-column norm. This could matter against ~1e-4 residuals if aligned, but establishes neither sign nor >=0.5% gain.

cost.local_conservative_arithmetic_bound: <50*n charged elementary-equivalent units per layer, <0.72M at1024x14 (~0.00028% of257G), excluding all changed future routes. Not a measured native tariff.
cost.expected_requests: A handful of vector/scalar operations per layer, no new matrix products/keys; actual full bill/requests required.

shortest_test.proposed: One parent/OFF/ON implementation+price pair on a root-designated already-explored public seed, with unchanged prefix, dual-diagonal cache, no accuracy selection. Then one fixed direct-native arm on prospectively allocated fresh16/OOS16, full retired pools, strict actual paired-net signs. Root may instead choose an explicit small diagnostic screen before full registration.
shortest_test.early_reject: If a registered diagnostic shows the direction only adds uncorrelated perturbation or materially worsens accuracy, close; do not sweep strength/bands on the same seeds.
shortest_test.not_authorized: No seed allocation, requests, imports, model calls, or deployable candidate created.

decision: Concrete cheap hypothesis for root prioritization; unbanked and unvalidated. >=0.5% remains the target, not an evidence-supported estimate.
